summary: CPI day. Hawkish FOMC minutes (Wed) clipped 45% of Monday's catch-up rally. SPY 656 on 20-DMA. Oil cooled from $102 to $94 on Iran de-escalation. BTC recovered to $70.8K on $640M ETF inflows. Q1 earnings kick off Friday with JPM/WFC/BLK.

risks.label: US CPI Release 12:30 GMT
risks.detail: Core consensus +0.3% m/m / +3.1% y/y. Any print above 3.2% core y/y kills June cut (from 48% to <30%) and sends SPY to 648 gap fill.

risks.label: Hawkish FOMC Minutes Echo
risks.detail: Wed minutes used 'patient' 11x, 'progress' 4x. Several members flagged premature easing risk. CPI is the referendum.

risks.label: Iran Hormuz Tail Still Alive
risks.detail: Deadline extended 10 days via Qatari mediation, but USS Gerald Ford repositioned to Gulf of Oman. Brent -7.8% but tail at 28% on Polymarket.

risks.label: Duration Unwind Risk
risks.detail: NVDA -1.8%, MSFT -1.3% Wed on rate repricing. A hot CPI extends the mega-cap tech unwind to 50-DMAs.

risks.label: DXY Breakout
risks.detail: 103.82 clean break of 103.40 resistance. Next 104.20 kills the soft-dollar thesis, pressure on EM and crypto.

risks.label: Q1 Bank Earnings Preview
risks.detail: JPM/WFC/BLK Friday. Steeper curve helps NIM but credit costs rising in autos/consumer.

risks.label: PLA Taiwan Drills Day 3
risks.detail: Live-fire continues through Saturday. Market numb but direct incident would crater SOXX.

events.label: US CPI March 12:30 GMT
events.detail: Today — critical binary event. Implied SPY move 0.9%.

events.label: DAL Earnings BMO
events.detail: Q1 airline read, Q2 fuel guide after oil spike.

events.label: ECB Lagarde Speech 14:00 CET
events.detail: Frankfurt Finance Summit. Pushback on Fed hawkish read?

events.label: EU 19th Sanctions Vote 10:00 CET
events.detail: Russian oil cap cut from $60 to $45.

opportunities.label: GLD — Asymmetric into CPI
opportunities.detail: Gold firm at $2,416 despite strong DXY. Entry $429-432, TP1 $442, TP2 $452, stop $421. R/R 1:2.1.

opportunities.label: SPY Straddle CPI Vol
opportunities.detail: ATM 656 straddle ~$6.20. Realized event move averaged 1.3% last 6 prints vs 0.9% implied.

opportunities.label: NVDA Short on Hot CPI
opportunities.detail: Only if core >0.3% m/m. Stop $112.50, TP1 $106, TP2 $102.50. Wait for the print.

opportunities.label: BTC ETF Flow Reversal
opportunities.detail: +$640M Tuesday (IBIT+FBTC) broke 4-day outflow streak. F&G climbed 22→31. Constructive if it holds 69.5K.

opportunities.label: European Refiners on Oil Cap
opportunities.detail: Neste, OMV leverage to $45 Russian cap enforcement.

regimes.label: Risk-Off Event-Driven
regimes.detail: SPY -0.74% Wed on hawkish minutes. VIX 22.8, 1-week 25.4. Bifurcated sentiment (equities cautious, crypto improving).

regimes.label: Curve Re-flattens
regimes.detail: 2s10s back to -7bp from -1bp. Hawkish minutes ate most of Monday's steepening. 2Y 4.48% / 10Y 4.41%.

regimes.label: DXY Breakout 103.82
regimes.detail: Clean break of 103.40. Next pivot 104.20 = soft-dollar thesis dead.

regimes.label: Oil War Premium Compression
regimes.detail: Brent $94 from $102. Iran diplomacy reopened, USO -3.8%. Trade is unwinding.
